name: AM-Poster
label: Box Art
about: a box-art carousel along the bottom over the game's full-screen backdrop
idea: CoinOPS "Poster" and "Bottom Spin" (a cover carousel with tilted neighbours along the bottom) - here over the game's own full-bleed backdrop, scrolled with UP / DOWN so LEFT / RIGHT keep the playlists
keys: UP / DOWN: previous / next box (the row is sideways, the menu is vertical)   LEFT / RIGHT: playlists
